your-mother-your-mother-your-mother-2026.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
your-mother-your-mother-your-mother-2026.description: Follows Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, who embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children after his wife dies, confronting forces closing in and beliefs threatening to unravel.

yuki-s-revenge-2025.title: Yuki's Revenge
yuki-s-revenge-2025.description: Visionary director Quentin Tarantino had a dream of a Kill Bill chapter that never made it to the silver screen, a chapter known as "Yuki's Revenge."

zodiac-2007.title: Zodiac
zodiac-2007.description: Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

zootopia-2-2025.title: Zootopia 2
zootopia-2-2025.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

abbott-elementary-2021.title: Abbott Elementary
abbott-elementary-2021.description: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don’t love the school district’s less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

avatar-seven-havens-2026.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
avatar-seven-havens-2026.description: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

breaking-bad-2008.title: Breaking Bad
breaking-bad-2008.description: Walter White, a New Mexico chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with Stage III cancer and given a prognosis of only two years left to live. He becomes filled with a sense of fearlessness and an unrelenting desire to secure his family's financial future at any cost as he enters the dangerous world of drugs and crime.

campus-drivers-2026.title: Campus Drivers
campus-drivers-2026.description: Lois arrives in Belrose with Max, the love of her life. Lane, the creator of Campus Drivers, the hottest app on campus, is known for never getting attached. Their paths were never meant to cross. But some encounters change everything, reopening old wounds. And when love appears unexpectedly, nothing is certain anymore.

dexter-resurrection-2025.title: Dexter: Resurrection
dexter-resurrection-2025.description: Set 10 weeks after Dexter: New Blood, Dexter Morgan chases a missing Harrison to New York City, where Captain Angel Batista is hot on their trail from way down in Miami.

doctor-x-mafia-in-white-2026.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White
doctor-x-mafia-in-white-2026.description: In a hospital dominated by ego and corruption, an enigmatic but brilliant surgeon arrives — taking on seemingly impossible cases amid fierce opposition.

dutton-ranch-2026.title: Dutton Ranch
dutton-ranch-2026.description: Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.

mobland-2025.title: MobLand
mobland-2025.description: Two mob families clash in a war that threatens to topple empires and lives.

modern-family-2009.title: Modern Family
modern-family-2009.description: The Pritchett-Dunphy-Tucker clan is a wonderfully large and blended family. They give us an honest and often hilarious look into the sometimes warm, sometimes twisted, embrace of the modern family.

percy-jackson-and-the-olympians-2023.title: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
percy-jackson-and-the-olympians-2023.description: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

south-park-1997.title: South Park
south-park-1997.description: Follow the misadventures of four irreverent grade-schoolers in the quiet, dysfunctional town of South Park, Colorado.

teach-you-a-lesson-2026.title: Teach You a Lesson
teach-you-a-lesson-2026.description: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

the-big-bang-theory-2007.title: The Big Bang Theory
the-big-bang-theory-2007.description: Physicists Leonard and Sheldon find their nerd-centric social circle with pals Howard and Raj expanding when aspiring actress Penny moves in next door.

the-chosen-2019.title: The Chosen
the-chosen-2019.description: The life of Christ through the eyes of those who encountered him.

the-lord-of-the-rings-the-rings-of-power.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power
the-lord-of-the-rings-the-rings-of-power.description: Beginning in a time of relative peace, we follow an ensemble cast of characters as they confront the re-emergence of evil to Middle-earth. From the darkest depths of the Misty Mountains, to the majestic forests of Lindon, to the breathtaking island kingdom of Númenor, to the furthest reaches of the map, these kingdoms and characters will carve out legacies that live on long after they are gone.

the-mentalist-2008.title: The Mentalist
the-mentalist-2008.description: Patrick Jane, a former celebrity psychic medium, uses his razor sharp skills of observation and expertise at "reading" people to solve serious crimes with the California Bureau of Investigation.

the-rookie-2018.title: The Rookie
the-rookie-2018.description: Starting over isn't easy, especially for small-town guy John Nolan who, after a life-altering incident, is pursuing his dream of being an LAPD officer. As the force's oldest rookie, he's met with skepticism from some higher-ups who see him as just a walking midlife crisis.

visionquest-2026.title: VisionQuest
visionquest-2026.description: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.
